title: Amprius Faces Pentagon 2028 Battery Ban Deadline With Partial China Supply Chain
digest:
Amprius faces potential stock pressure if it fails to meet Pentagon’s 2028 battery sourcing deadline, as shares already reflect compliance success expectations.
Its growth relies on U.S. defense drone demand but remains partially China-dependent in supply chain ahead of the deadline.
Key catalysts include CAMINUS production start, China export controls, and securing non-Chinese suppliers—each critical to Pentagon compliance.
Rating机构 currently rates 'Hold' for 12–18 months, citing offsetting risks from robust drone battery demand and unresolved supply chain issues.

（注：中文摘要已按要求结构拆分，实际英文输出需保持相同逻辑）
